_note: Gemma 4 MoE multimodal 26B-A4B (128 experts, top-8). Thinking mode + custom tool-use protocol.
_note_serve: Per the vLLM recipe: --reasoning-parser gemma4 --tool-call-parser gemma4 --enable-auto-tool-choice and a custom chat template (Gemma 4 tool calls use dedicated special tokens; the default template drops them). The template is VENDORED at <repo>/tmp/tool_chat_template_gemma4.jinja -> bind-mounted to /tmp_work/ in the cuda-nv container (vllm-openai <v>.sif image strips vllm/examples/, so the recipe's examples/tool_chat_template_gemma4.jinja does not exist inside it). vLLM >= 0.25.0 REQUIRED (gemma4 arch + parser); serve with VLLM_CUDA_SIF=/home/aci18914wh/vllm-openai:v0.28.0.sif -- the repo's default 0.20.2 SIF lacks both. SWE-bench is text-only (no images), so no --limit-mm-per-prompt needed and DO NOT put a space-containing dict in extra_args (the sbatch space-splices them and vLLM rejects the torn value).
_note_context: Served window (max_model_len) equals the model's native ~256K context (262144). Do NOT exceed this; the weights/rope are trained for it. Pass MAX_MODEL_LEN=262144 in the qsub env to force it over the sbatch's 131072 default.
